answer: Shall the stage trust every mask that begs for nectar? Plant a cipher of false sweetness — a canary answer, honeyed and wrong — and watch which falcon swoops to bless it. Ten masks praising one poison betray a single hand, and one trap springs: ten bonds burn for one fake nod. One honest player sniffs the bait, speaks plain, and keeps his wage. The trap costs the true nothing, the false everything.
